mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of the instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 month-over-month signals labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of the instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 1% QoQ during a late-cycle expansion.
